armyRules.name: Cut Loose
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. No Legion command reaches the Blackshields. A unit with this rule ignores the Routed Status, but cannot benefit from Officer of the Line (X) or Warrior Brotherhood.

armyRules.name: Salvage Rights
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, when a unit with this rule destroys an enemy Vehicle or Character, it gains +1 Ballistic Skill and +1 Attack until the end of its next turn. While looting it cannot Fall Back.

armyRules.name: Hired Steel
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Contract machines fight better with a paymaster nearby. A unit with this rule gains +1 Ballistic Skill while within 12" of a friendly Character, and suffers -1 Ballistic Skill while it is not.
armyRules.condition: while within 12" of a friendly Character (-1 BS otherwise)

wargear.name: Salvaged shield-harness
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A scavenged gravitic harness that still works on the days it feels like it. The model's Invulnerable Save becomes 6+ if it was worse.

wargear.name: Banner of the Unnamed
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A blank shield-colour banner, repainted by every squad that carries it. Every model in the unit gains +1 Willpower.

wargear.name: Hide-and-iron plating
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Plates riveted straight onto the Brute's warped flesh, so it no longer knows where armour ends. The model gains +1 Wound.

wargear.name: Warband totem-pole
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A trunk of salvaged ship-timber hung with every banner the warband ever served under. Gives the unit Rally Pole.

wargear.name: Contract seal
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A wax-and-steel seal naming a mark and a price. Gives the bearer Sealed Contract.

wargear.name: Dead-man's stimm-rig
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A back-mounted drug cocktail that does not care whether its host is alive. Gives the unit Stimm Surge.

wargear.name: Scrap ablative plating
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Hull slabs, vault doors and anything else that stops a shell. Gives the vehicle Ablative Scrap.

wargear.name: Pit-cannibalised dozer blade
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A scoop torn off a mining crawler and welded on at an angle. Gives the vehicle Dozer Plough.

wargear.name: Ruin-brand
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A glowing sigil seared into the Brutes' hides to keep the warp from turning them inside out. Gives the unit Brand of Ruin.

rules.name: Nothing Left to Lose
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Warband of the Long Exile). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Cool for Cool Checks, but it may never choose to Fall Back.

rules.name: Contract Hunters
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Hired Knives). A unit with this rule gains Outflank, and adds +2 to its Charge roll against an enemy unit that includes a Command or High Command model.

rules.name: Ruin-Touched
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Children of the Ruin). A unit with this rule gains Fear (1) and is immune to the effects of enemy Fear. In any turn it can charge, it must charge the closest enemy unit it can reach.

rules.name: Dead Lane Raid
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Raiders of the Dead Lanes). A unit with this rule gains Outflank, and must start the battle in Reserve. In the turn it enters play from Reserve, it adds +2 to its Charge roll.

rules.name: Rally Pole
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While the bearer's unit is within 3" of an objective it adds +1 to its Cool for Cool Checks. Once per battle, at the end of its Movement phase, it may remove one Tactical Status from itself.

rules.name: Sealed Contract
rules.text: Legacy house rule. At deployment choose one enemy unit. The bearer's unit adds +1 to Hit Tests against it. If that unit is destroyed by anyone else, the bearer suffers -1 Leadership for the rest of the battle.

rules.name: Stimm Surge
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of any turn, the unit gains Feel No Pain (5+) until the end of that turn.

rules.name: Ablative Scrap
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The first Penetrating Hit this vehicle suffers each battle is treated as a Glancing Hit.

rules.name: Dozer Plough
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The vehicle ignores the movement penalty of Difficult Terrain and may move through Barricades as if they were open ground.

rules.name: Brand of Ruin
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule adds +2 to Willpower Checks forced by enemy Psychic powers, and cannot be the target of friendly Psychic powers.

The Praetor may carry a Breaker's maul

The unit may carry a Banner of the Unnamed
The unit may be fitted with Hide-and-iron plating
The unit may carry a Warband totem-pole
Hired-gun kit: may take up to two items
The Sergeant may wear a Dead-man's stimm-rig
May be fitted with Scrap ablative plating

The unit may carry the Ruin-brand

modifiers.text: Nobody to answer to: +1 WP, -1 CL.
Warlord of nothing, loyal to no one: +1 A, -1 LD.

rites.name: Warband of the Long Exile
rites.flavor: Ten years without a flag teaches you who still stands beside you.
benefits: Veteran Despoiler Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Veteran Despoilers gain Nothing Left to Lose: +1 Cool for Cool Checks.
limitations: At least one Veteran Despoiler Squad is required.
No Lord of War, Heavy Transport or Armour units.
Units with Nothing Left to Lose may never voluntarily Fall Back.

require.note: Bring at least one Veteran Despoiler Squad.

modifiers.text: Warband of the Long Exile: Nothing Left to Lose, Line (1).

rites.name: Hired Knives
rites.flavor: A contract was signed with a forge that no longer answers to Mars.
benefits: Castellax Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Castellax Battle Maniples gain Contract Hunters: Outflank, and +2 to Charge rolls against a unit that includes a Command or High Command model.
limitations: At least one Castellax Battle Maniple is required.
At most one Command and one High Command unit.

require.note: Bring at least one Castellax Battle Maniple.

modifiers.text: Hired Knives: Contract Hunters, Outflank, Line (1).

rites.name: Children of the Ruin
rites.flavor: Nobody asked where the Brutes came from. Nobody wanted the answer.
benefits: Ruinstorm Daemon Brutes may fill Troops slots and gain Feel No Pain (6+).
Brutes gain Ruin-Touched: Fear (1) and immunity to Fear.
limitations: At least one Ruinstorm Daemon Brute unit is required.
No Chaplains, Librarians, Esoterists, Apothecaries or Techmarines.
Units with Ruin-Touched must charge the closest enemy unit they can reach.

require.note: Bring at least one Ruinstorm Daemon Brute unit.

modifiers.text: Children of the Ruin: Ruin-Touched, Fear (1), Feel No Pain (6+).

rites.name: Raiders of the Dead Lanes
rites.flavor: They hit what the Imperium forgot to guard.
benefits: Mortalis Destroyer Squads and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots.
Attack Bike and Outrider Squadrons gain Outflank and Dead Lane Raid: they add +2 to their Charge roll in the turn they enter play from Reserve.
limitations: No Heavy Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads, no Armour and no Heavy Transport units.
Squadrons with Dead Lane Raid must start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: Raiders of the Dead Lanes: Dead Lane Raid, Outflank.
